newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zambia says ZCCM privatisation on track.
newsitem.headline: Zambia says ZCCM privatisation on track.

text.p: Zambian officials on Thursday expressed surprise at the news that Gencor Ltd had decided to pull out of a consortium to develop the country's Konkola Deep copper mine.
But Finance Minister Ronald Penza said Zambia remained on track to start selling assets of the giant Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) concern by the end of next month.
"We should be able to start the sales process by the end of next month," he told Reuters at an investment conference.
He added that not all ZCCM assets might be ready for disposal by the June 30 target date as the government and potential buyers negotiated terms for the various packages on offer.
The government last month invited six bidders for the final negotiations of the sale of ZCCM assets, including Konkola Deep which has been lumped in one tranche with the Mufulira smelter.
